elements.name: slide-subtitle
elements.text: Target: 10 weeks, subject to the selected design, agreed working availability and confirmed pilot workflow.

Week	Milestone	Planned output
Week 6	Connect processing & recipients	Link processors, lots and recipients. Test origin links and each participant's permitted access.
Week 7	Publish the consumer view	Build public summaries, approvals and QR downloads. Test published, private and unknown IDs.
Week 8	Connect the landing experience	Connect the catalogue and chosen design. Check mobile, QR and reduced motion. First review round.
Week 9	Review & accept the pilot	Complete the second review round, pilot acceptance and final workflow, permission and device checks.
Week 10	Launch & transfer	Launch with HTTPS and backups. Check restore, train operators and confirm the support handover.

elements.name: text-67
elements.text: Review rounds are proposed for Weeks 8 and 9. Client feedback or scope changes may move launch.
